dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: "She didn't wake up. Days passed. Then weeks. I sat by her side, waiting for a laugh, a smile, anything."
dialog.internal: [Visual: Hospital room. Monitors beeping faintly. Tori unconscious in bed, bandaged, IV drip. Ronnie sits beside her, eyes hollow. The Tamagotchi rests on the bedside table, faint light pulsing.]
